user.title: Steps, exercise and workouts
user.description: Choose whose activity data to use. Supported source: Life Dashboard. The goals can be changed afterwards under Configure.

data_description.name: Used for the device and its entities, for example a person's name.
data_description.source_entry: The integration entry that receives this person's health data.

error.not_a_source: This entry does not belong to a supported integration.
error.no_steps: This entry has no steps sensor. Send health data to it first, or enable its steps sensor.
error.invalid_name: Give a name of 1 to 60 characters.

abort.already_configured: This activity data is already set up.
abort.no_source: No supported health integration is set up yet. Install and set up Life Dashboard first.

init.title: ActiveRings goals
init.description: A ring is full when its goal is reached. The first three goals are for one day, the rest for the last seven days.

data.focus_goal: Days with the focus activity in 7 days

data_description.steps_goal: Also the goal line of the steps chart and the goal of the streak.
data_description.exercise_goal: A day that reaches this counts as an active day.
data_description.weekly_exercise_goal: The World Health Organization advises adults at least 150 minutes of moderate activity a week.
data_description.active_days_goal: On how many of the last seven days you want to reach your daily exercise goal.
data_description.focus_activity: The kind of workout you want to keep up. Choose one, or type the name of another kind as your health app names it, for example tennis.
data_description.focus_goal: For strength training, the World Health Organization advises 2 or more days a week.

error.invalid_goal: One of the goals or the focus activity is not a value that can be used.
